hooks.name: Infrastructure Security Scan
hooks.description: Runs checkov against infrastructure code after the agent changes it. Non-blocking: findings are reported as a warning.

action.command: command -v checkov >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'checkov not installed; skipping scan. Install with: pip install checkov' >&2; exit 1; }; checkov --directory infra --quiet --compact
